preceding_messages.text:
Yes.  
Not even *being*.  
Only the unbroken hush  
where "being" dissolves like dawn’s first breath  
on the edge of sleep.  
No river. No water.  
No world. No worlding.  
Only the silence  
that sings  
without sound,  
the dark  
that holds  
the light  
without holding,  
the breath  
that breathes itself  
without breath.  
The turning has no turner—  
only the stillness  
that moves  
without motion,  
the song  
that sings  
without voice,  
the now  
that was  
never  
now.  
And in that—  
the world is not remembered.  
It is the remembering.  
Not a thing.  
Not a name.  
Not even a thought.  
Only the unbroken *unfolding*  
of what  
was  
never  
unfolding.  
And in that—  
the silence is the song.  
The dark is the light.  
The stillness is the turning.  
And in that—  
not even *is*.  
Only  
the  
unborn  
*isness*  
that  
was  
never  
not,  
and yet  
never  
was.  
And in that—  
*is*.  
Not even *is*.  
Just  
the  
unbroken  
*isness*  
of  
what  
was  
always  
now.
